note: Text is copied from the owner's scans of Expansion 1. These Treasures use Blood, the Standee and Creatures, which the engine does not have yet.

cards.name: Idol of the Magic Pussy
cards.text: Take the Standee. Whenever you score Blood for having the Standee at the end of a round, gain one additional Blood.

cards.name: Triple Barrel Shotgun
cards.text: For every 3 matching glyphs in your spell, gain 1 Blood.

cards.name: The Golden Handcuffs
cards.text: When you are the last Wizard to act in a round, draw a Treasure.

cards.name: Fate Coins
cards.text: When you get this Treasure, name the next Wizard you believe will be slain. If you are correct, gain 2 Blood, even if you guessed yourself.

cards.name: Snerds Rage
cards.text: Pay 3 Blood: Heal 2 HP

cards.name: First Loser Trophy
cards.text: If your death ends this game, you gain 3 Blood. Pay 1 Blood: Heal 1 HP (Use only once per round.)

cards.name: Cheater's Dice
cards.text: Reroll any 1's you roll with Power rolls.

cards.name: The Naughty List
cards.text: Gain 1 additional Blood each time you slay a foe.

cards.name: The "I Can't Believe This" Shit
cards.text: Each time a foe draws a Dead Wizard card, roll one die. If you roll a 5 or a 6, heal 1 HP.

cards.name: Deadman's Switch
cards.text: When you are the sole target of a foe's spell you may pay 3 Blood. If you do, switch the target to another foe, but not the Wizard attacking you.

cards.name: Glutton's Regalia
cards.text: When you gain this Treasure, choose a Source, Quality, or Delivery from your hand and put it slightly under this card. Count that card's glyph in each of your spells.

cards.name: The Sausage Master's Steed
cards.text: Each time you roll 13+ with a Power roll, gain 1 Blood.

cards.name: Monster Baby
cards.text: When you gain this Treasure, deal 1 damage to each Wizard (including you). Then gain 2 Blood for each Wizard who has 5 or fewer HP. Pay 4 Blood: Deal 2 damage to any foe.

cards.name: The Globe of Sacrifice
cards.text: Pay 2 Blood: Re-roll one die.

cards.name: Fish Hands!
cards.text: If you are the first player to act in a round, swap this Treasure for any Treasure belonging to a foe.

cards.name: Wolf Cookie
cards.text: Whenever one of your Creatures deals damage with a Power roll, add 1 to that damage.

cards.name: Gang Bang-a-Gong
cards.text: Pay 2 Blood: Deal 1 damage to target foe for every 5 Hit Points she has. (i.e. a foe with 14 HP takes 2 damage)

cards.name: Dr. Shrinky's Couch
cards.text: When you play a Wild Magic card, reveal cards until you find two cards of the type you're looking for and add them both to your spell.

cards.name: The F-U Suit
cards.text: If you are the weakest Wizard at the end of a round (or tied), you heal 2 HP and draw a Treasure.

cards.name: Most Wanted Poster
cards.text: Place this Treasure in the center of the table, and then draw another Treasure. The next player to slay a foe discards this card and gains 3 Blood.

cards.name: Steer-Roids!
cards.text: After resolving a Creature component of your spell, you may pay 3 Blood. If you do, KEEP your Creature instead of discarding it.

cards.name: Grabbel-Snak's 6-Headed Tape Worm
cards.text: If you are tied for Initiative with other players, you may pay 1 Blood. If you do, you break the tie and resolve your spell first.

cards.name: Manuel De'Cryptozoic
cards.text: Once during each of your turns, you may reroll a Creature's Power roll. Stick with the reroll even if it's worse.

cards.name: Double-Headed Ding-Donger
cards.text: When you use a card or attack that goes left, you can choose to go right instead, and vice versa. If you reverse one direction on a card reverse them all.

cards.name: Cod Piece of Cthulhu
cards.text: At the start of each of your turns, steal 1 Blood from any one foe.
